fieldValues.title: Does confidence built from relations need a promotion step before it carries authority?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (7. Against: why affirmation exists), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Never authority: confidence only sets how much care work gets.
- B. Promotion by an owner act, as Office over Testimony requires.
- C. Promotion by a threshold, confirmed in a session.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which acts confidence would be used for: ranking, merging, gating.
fieldValues.next_action: Map each act in the care policy and the desk to the authority it needs today.
